Only additive migration 0010_hooks.sql (P16-owned) and additive migrations.go registry edits.

repair_cycle_1 fixed every listed finding (see repair_cycle_1): P1-1 nested-return propagation, P1-2 capability binding/endpoint derivation/durable budget/params allowlist, P2-3 integration-handoff seam (no P14/P15 lifecycle file edited), P2-4 payload method/path overrides removed, P2-5 3xx is retryable, P2-6 MaxCallDepth + recover, P3-7 atomic 0600 key write + perms, P3-8/P3-9 coalesce identity+budget preservation, P3-10/P3-17 audits folded into the mutation transactions, P3-11 randomHookID fail-closed, P3-12 https-only hook definitions, P3-13 retry+Operation in one transaction, P3-14 vm.deadline removed, P3-15 exact env allowlist gate, P3-16 shared once-built child + repeated -count=10 stability.

P1-2 oracle closure is asserted by TestBrokerRefusesUnboundDisallowedAndExhausted and re-asserted end-to-end in TestAliDnsFullPathFixture: an unbound (hook,secret) pair -> ErrSecretNotBoundToHook, no budget -> ErrNoSignatureBudget, query placement without allowlist -> ErrNoParamsAllowlist, a disallowed script-selected param -> ErrParamNotAllowlisted, a deviating endpoint -> ErrEndpointDeviation, and a budget=1 secret refuses its second signature -> ErrSignatureBudgetExhausted (durable SignatureUsage 1/1).

P1-2 endpoint derivation is proven by the AliDNS fixture: the event payload claims method DELETE and path /wrong but the signed request is POST https://dns.aliyuncs.com/ (path from the hook URL), and the final Signature recomputes to base64(HMAC-SHA1('AliDNS-AccessKeySecret&', 'POST&%2F&' + PercentEncode(canonical-without-Signature))).

Story 5 real gate: TestSandboxRealIsolationGate + TestSandboxRunnerExecutesIsolatedScript PASS on this host with ANTINAT_DEDICATED_UID=12001 ANTINAT_DEDICATED_GID=12001. The P3-16 fix builds cmd/antinat-hook-runner ONCE (sync.Once) so a cold 'go build' cannot race the gates; the focused -count=10 set passed twice back-to-back plus a count=1 (no cold-start gate failure observed). The failure is NOT retried away; a genuine gate failure still fails.

Secret handling: secret values are AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest and never returned; the broker decrypts in-process, reserves one durable budget unit, signs exactly one normalized final allowlisted request, and zeroizes. The 0600 key file is written atomically and its permissions are enforced on load.

Story 6 fixture: TestAliDnsFullPathFixture PASS — lifecycle event enqueued only after a durable recorded/verified state event; the in-process runner computes the canonical AliDNS request; the broker validates the contribution against its own normalization, checks the allowlist, reserves the secret budget, and signs; a stub sender (no network) delivers. Signature verified by local recomputation; no secret material in URL/body/headers.

TestServiceWiredPreparerSignsWebhook PASS — production Service composes the real DeliveryPreparer; a secret bound (BindSecretToHook) + budgeted (SetSecretSignatureBudget) webhook is delivered header-placement signed.

SSRF transport: ignore proxy env, resolve-then-validate-ALL A/AAAA (reject any blocked address), IP-pin while preserving SNI/Host, redirect revalidation per hop, redirected credentials stripped cross-origin, forbidden headers/userinfo/IP-literal ambiguity/CRLF rejected, gzip-decompression bytes bounded, raw+header bytes bounded.

OS isolation child: CLONE_NEWNET|CLONE_NEWNS, chroot, dedicated non-nobody UID/GID, EXACT allowlisted env (P3-15), no inherited FDs, NoNewPrivileges, amd64 seccomp denying socket/socketpair/connect/execve(execveat)/ptrace/mount/fork/vfork, RLIMIT_NPROC/CPU/AS, 64KiB capped output, process-group tree-kill. ProbeSolidGate fails closed to webhook-only on any missing gate.
Race/cluster: no DATA RACE reported anywhere in the brief's race gate (hook + api, -count=10).
known_limits: govulncheck is not available in this environment; no PASS is recorded for vulnerability scanning.

The real Linux OS-isolation gate requires root plus a provisioned dedicated identity (ANTINAT_DEDICATED_UID/GID = 12001 naming /etc/passwd antinat-sandbox). On any host without it the capability degrades to webhook-only (fail-closed, asserted, never a skipped PASS); on Windows the !linux sandbox_other.go keeps the package compiling and webhook-only. No Windows runtime execution was performed (cross-build only).

P2-3 subsystem-island integration handoff: EnqueueLifecycleEvent / EnqueueEvent / MarkDecommissioned remain the PUBLIC, documented, armed integration seams — the dispatcher pump + at-least-once + decommission-drop semantics are verified by tests. Production lifecycle->webhook enqueue wiring (forward-delete durable events; node decommission/uninstall bounded best-effort drop) is an explicit P17/P19 composition point consuming these seams. NO P14/P15 lifecycle file was modified (ownership preserved); this bounded repair cycle deliberately left the seams unwired in production.

Story 6 fixture (and the in-process runner used by dispatcher tests) exercises the same interpreter code the OS-isolated child runs; the OS-isolation boundary itself is a separate production mitigation, proven by the real-gate tests that exec the production cmd/antinat-hook-runner child. In-process fixtures never claim OS isolation.

No real-WAN, real-AliDNS, or real-Agent network evidence is fabricated: all delivery-path proofs use an injected resolver/dialer or a stub sender, and the AliDNS signature is verified by local recomputation against the plaintext secret.

The P15-documented pre-existing store-package `-race -count=10` M4 time-budget issue is explicitly out of P16 scope; this phase's race gate (./internal/hook ./internal/controller/api -count=10) passed with no DATA RACE.

SignatureNonce is produced by crypto/rand and Timestamp by the runner runtime (UTC AS-MINUTE); both are non-deterministic, so the fixture verifies signatures by recomputing the canonical query from the final URL (Signature stripped) rather than from a fixed nonce.

P1-2 internal wiring (BindSecretToHook / SetSecretSignatureBudget / SetHookParamsAllowlist and the hook_secret_bindings / allow_params_json / signature_budget columns of migration 0010) is deliberately NOT part of the frozen OpenAPI surface; it is exposed only as internal Go API for tests and future P17 wiring. An unbound/budgetless secret and a script-chosen non-allowlisted param are refused by the broker (never a signing oracle).

P3-16 does not retry real-gate failures away: the child is built once up front so a cold `go build` (~1.2s, matching the single observed cold-start failure) cannot race the namespace/uid/seccomp gates; a genuine gate violation still fails the probe. The focused -count=10 set was run three times on the provisioned identity (2x count=10 + 1x count=1) with zero failures.

red_reasons.story_1: RED: before Story 1 there was no durable delivery queue — no hook_deliveries table, no at-least-once state machine, no bounded backoff, and no queue-full/DLQ/decommission policy; a webhook event had no durable store to reach a DELIVERED state.
red_reasons.story_2: RED: before Story 2 there was no SSRF-safe transport — a plain net/http request to a private/loopback/documented-blocked address would succeed instead of being rejected (no resolve-then-validate-ALL pinning, no blocked-range check, no bounds).
red_reasons.story_3: RED: before Story 3 secret values were not stored encrypted at rest and no broker existed — the API had no hook-secret routes and no signing path that could bind a secret capability to exactly one normalized final allowlisted request.
red_reasons.story_4: RED: before Story 4 no isolated JS runner existed — a scripted delivery had no interpreter, no step/time/output bounds, and no no-bridge runtime; requiring/fetch/process were not errors because nothing implemented the surface.
red_reasons.story_5: RED: before Story 5 the JS capability had no OS isolation and no fail-closed webhook-only gate — the in-process interpreter alone was used unconditionally, nothing rejected the shared nobody identity or a missing dedicated-identity provision, and the non-Linux build did not compile a closed fallback.
red_reasons.story_6: RED: before Story 6 the production DeliveryPreparer did not exist (the Service dispatcher was constructed with a nil preparer), so a scripted delivery had NO code path from the durable queue to a signed, sender-ready request; TestAliDnsFullPathFixture asserts that full path end-to-end.
red_reasons.repair_P1_1: RED: before the repair, a `return` nested inside if/for/block was evaluated-and-discarded, so the function continued and returned the wrong value; the broker could sign/deliver the wrong request.
red_reasons.repair_P1_2: RED: before the repair, Sign signed whatever intent.Method/Path/Query the caller passed, the fixture could influence method/path from the event payload (requestMethod/requestPath overrides), hook_secrets had no hook_id, and nothing durably bounded total signatures per secret (an unlimited HMAC oracle).
red_reasons.repair_P2_5: RED: before the repair, dispatcher.go only failed on >=400, so a terminal 3xx (redirects off) was recorded as DELIVERED though no final endpoint was reached.
red_reasons.repair_P2_6: RED: before the repair, MaxCallDepth was declared but never enforced and Runner.Run had no panic recovery, so a deep-recursion/adversarial script could overflow the Go stack and abort the controller.
red_reasons.repair_P3_x: RED: before the repair, the secret key file was written non-atomically with no perms check; coalesce clobbered event_id and inherited exhausted budgets from FAILED rows; audits were swallowed or post-commit; randomHookID degraded to a degenerate id; http:// webhooks could never be delivered; retry created the Operation after the requeue; vm.deadline was dead; the env gate checked one magic variable; and two real-gate tests each ran a cold `go build` concurrently with the gates.

fixed_findings.P1-1: nested return sentinel (retSignal) propagated through execStmt/execBranch/execForOf/block; callValue aborts on it; tests prove if- and for-nested returns short-circuit to the early value.
fixed_findings.P1-2: secret sealed to hook (internal hook_secret_bindings + BindSecretToHook; Sign refuses unbound pair with ErrSecretNotBoundToHook); endpoint derived exclusively from the hook definition URL (POST/path/host/scheme/port) with broker-side re-derivation and ErrEndpointDeviation; durable per-secret signature_budget/signature_issued with atomic reserve (ErrNoSignatureBudget/ErrSignatureBudgetExhausted); per-hook allow_params_json allowlist (SetHookParamsAllowlist; ErrNoParamsAllowlist/ErrParamNotAllowlisted) applied to query-placement signing only; MaxCalls per-request bound consulted in Prepare.
fixed_findings.P2-3: kept the public enqueue seam (EnqueueLifecycleEvent/EnqueueEvent/MarkDecommissioned) armed + documented; added a known_limits entry stating production lifecycle->webhook wiring is a P17/P19 composition seam; no P14/P15 lifecycle file touched.
fixed_findings.P2-4: removed requestMethod/requestPath and firstNonEmpty payload overrides; the payload can no longer influence method/path (see P1-2).
fixed_findings.P2-5: dispatcher now fails any >=300 (only 2xx is DELIVERED); TestDispatcher3xxIsRetryableFailureNotDelivered.
fixed_findings.P2-6: MaxCallDepth enforced in callValue frame push/check; Runner.Run wrapped in recover() converting panics into a bounded ErrRunnerPanic error; valueToGo depth-bounded so a cyclic object fails closed instead of a fatal stack overflow; tests for deep recursion, recovered panic (10 % 0.5), and cyclic refusal.
fixed_findings.P3-7: secret key written atomically (temp file + fsync + rename, 0600 temp); load verifies/requires 0600 (fail closed, best-effort on Windows); tests for loose-perm rejection and 0600 create.
fixed_findings.P3-8: coalesce no longer rewrites the target row's event_id; TestCoalescePreservesEventID proves dedup identity survives and re-enqueue dedups.
fixed_findings.P3-9: coalescing onto a FAILED row resets state=PENDING, attempt_count=0, next_attempt_at=now (fresh budget/backoff); TestCoalesceOntoFailedResetsBudget.
fixed_findings.P3-10: audits are folded into the mutation transaction in coalesce/drop/DLQ/retry/MarkFailed-DLQ/MarkDecommissioned; a failed audit rolls back and surfaces as an error (no silent swallow).
fixed_findings.P3-11: randomHookID returns an error on crypto/rand failure (fail closed) instead of a degenerate stable id; callers propagate it.
fixed_findings.P3-12: validateHookURL now requires https (matches the SSRF client default); http:// hook definitions are rejected.
fixed_findings.P3-13: RetryDeliveryAndRecord requeues the delivery and inserts the api_operations 202 record in ONE transaction; the API handler uses it and reads the committed operation for the 202.
fixed_findings.P3-14: removed the unused vm.deadline field (time budgets are enforced via ctx/step budget).
fixed_findings.P3-15: the env-isolation gate now verifies the child received EXACTLY the allowlisted environment (no extras, no missing keys), not a single magic variable; new internal unit test + the real env gate.
fixed_findings.P3-16: root cause: two real-gate tests each ran `go build` for their own child inside the test, so a cold build cache (~1.2s, matching the observed failure timing) ran concurrently with the namespace/uid/seccomp gates and produced a one-off cold-start failure. Fix: build the child ONCE before the gates (package-level sync.Once). No gate result is retried away. Focused -count=10 run twice + count=1, all PASS.
